Book your table before you come.

Demo login

See it from the other side — one tap

This demo has two staff logins. Tap one and you are straight in — no name, email or PIN to type. Switch back any time with Log out (top right).

Prefer the full sign-in flow? Use the Login button at the top right — it asks “staff or owner?” and takes the same demo details: Staff — name employee, PIN 1234 · Owner — ID admin, PIN 4321. In the live version these demo logins are removed and real PINs are set by the owner.

Table availability

Check this before you book — it shows every table for the date picked below: which are free, which are already booked and for what slot, and booked till what time. Change the date in the form and this board updates with it.

Free — no bookings Booked — slot & till-time shown Playing right now

A table can take more than one booking in a day — only the exact slots listed are taken; everything around them is free to book. If a table is playing right now, it's a walk-in game with no fixed end time — the counter starts your booked slot on time regardless.

Reserve a table

The moment you confirm, your booking lands on the supervisor's screen at the counter — they will keep your table ready.
Estimated table charge — ₹0
Pick a table, date and time — availability for that slot shows here.

Final billing is always by actual play time at the club's per-minute rate — the estimate is just so you know what to expect. Free cancellation up to 30 minutes before your slot.

My Record & Bookings

Your phone number is your key — no login, no password.

Enter the number you booked or played with. If you saved your details, your full record opens — visits, frames won/lost, minutes played, total spent, last visit and pending dues — along with every booking under that number. Demo tip: try 98110 22334 (a sample regular with a saved record) or 99360 48120 (a first-time booker with no record saved).

Privacy: your record opens only with your own number, and your name and number never appear anywhere public — the availability board above shows booked slots and times only, never who booked them. Guest players who never save their details have no record at all.

Add a student

Name, joining date and monthly fee are all it takes — the new student starts with this month's fee Pending and 0 sessions.

Fee due dates roll forward from each student's joining day every month — pay on time and the next due date appears on its own; leave it pending and it shows as overdue until collected.

Regular players, keyed by mobile number — no login portal, no app. A profile is created only when a player opts in ("Save my details") while booking, or the counter starts them as a Saved player; every booking and session under that number then lands on their record automatically. Guest walk-ins are never saved — they are billed and gone. Two sample regulars are pre-loaded so the record shape is visible.

A customer's name and number are visible only to staff — never on the public availability board or anywhere another customer can see.

Table rates

What players pay per minute of play time. Changes apply to tables that are free right away; a table mid-game keeps the rate it started with.

Booking notifications

New bookings appear in the Supervisor's Bookings list the moment a player confirms — no setup needed. In the full version, the club can also get every booking as a WhatsApp message to the counter's number, the moment it is made — that hookup is part of the live build.

Who sees what

Customer — the public website: Book Now, Amenities, Shop, Services. No login, ever — the phone number is the key.
Supervisor — current tables and frame control, bookings, today's + this week's earnings, and the Pending account — in this demo the Supervisor can also clear pending dues from it (mark a bill share or a student fee collected by Cash or UPI-Scanner). Monthly totals, the full Day Book history, rates and settings stay Admin-only.
Admin (owner) — everything: all earnings and history, the full Day Book, students, bookings and these settings.
Sign-in — the Login button (top right) opens a separate sign-in page that asks "staff or owner?": staff sign in with their staff name + PIN and land on the Supervisor view; the owner signs in with owner ID + PIN and gets full Admin.
Customer profiles — regulars are saved by mobile number only when they opt in; guests are never saved. A customer's name and number never appear on the public availability board.

Sign in

Are you the staff or are you the owner?

Pick one — staff run the counter, the owner sees and controls everything. Customers don't sign in at all: booking and records work with just a phone number.

⚡ Demo login — one tap, no typing

Just trying the demo? Skip the forms below and jump straight in as either role:

Forgot your PIN? The owner resets staff PINs from Admin — it takes ten seconds. Every bill you save is tagged with your name.

Forgot your PIN? In the live version the owner resets it with the one-time recovery code given at setup.

Demo login details — so you can check both sides yourself:
Supervisor (staff): name employee · PIN 1234
Owner (admin): ID admin · PIN 4321
Or use the one-tap buttons above — they sign in with these same two accounts. In the live version the demo details are removed, the real PINs are set by the owner and checked on the server — they never appear in the page itself.

Customers: no login, no password, no account — your phone number is your key for bookings and your record. Customer accounts arrive with the Shop in version two, so anything you order there is saved under your account.
